title: Tour of Bulgaria — Sales Bicycle Race
description: Virtual 2,500 km road course reconstructed from three Google Maps sessions and enriched with 96 ordered inner towns/villages for fine-grained progress tracking. The 2,500 km competition scale is rounded from the road route produced when all anchors are retained.

distance_model.basis: All 96 ordered route anchors are retained as routing waypoints; the routed road result is approximately 2,500 km.
distance_model.note: competition_km is the canonical UI/scoring distance. Runtime routing may vary slightly as map and road data change.

source_sessions.label: Plovdiv → Pazardzhik → Bansko → Gotse Delchev → Sandanski → Blagoevgrad → Dupnitsa → Sofia

routing.fallback: Join route_anchors as a LineString in listed order.
routing.precision_note: The HTML requests road geometry online from OSRM using all 96 ordered anchors. The canonical progress scale is 2,500 km; if OSRM is unavailable, the map displays the ordered anchor polyline.
